warnings: op1 direct read (house 10). These roof-level beam marks (RB-prefix) all use smaller Ø12mm main bar than the floor-level B-prefix beams' Ø16mm (S-11) — consistent with lighter roof-only loads on the metal-sheet roof structure.

RB1B (4.95m span, no mid-column at grid B-4 per S-05's warning) carries the heaviest reinforcement of this set (up to 6-Ø12mm bottom) — consistent with it being an edge beam bearing an intermediate beam (RB1A) at mid-span, per S-05's beam-on-beam note.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: main_bar/stirrup were stored as free-text strings in this house (only houses 10 and 11 did this; the other 9 use nested objects). Converted to the schema section 6 object form. The exact original string is preserved verbatim in printed_as on every converted field, so nothing was lost and the parse can be re-checked against the drawing. 'Ø' was read as type RB per schema section 6. Thai annotations in parentheses (lap-splice/continuation notes) were carried into note. A 'tie'/'tie_bar' key was renamed to 'stirrup' to match the other houses. ⚠️ Bars printed with a mid-span/L-8 qualifier were NOT merged into a face count — that needs the section-7 leader-line check against the drawing image, which has not been done for this house yet.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: this house stored section data in per-file ad-hoc arrays (beams, column_sections) instead of the elements[] that houses 01-09 use. Folded into elements[] with element_id/element_type, and mark->element_id, size_m -> width_mm/height_mm, thickness_m -> thickness_mm, rebar/top/bottom strings -> objects. Every original string is kept in a *_printed_as field. NOTE: the array named 'column_sections' actually held BEAM sections - every cut_ref names a B-mark - so those became element_type 'beam', with the cut label kept in section_ref. confidence_score is null because this house never recorded one; it was NOT invented.
